_readme: Where each value is stamped onto INFINITY RIO RANCH - Rental Agreement.pdf.
The template has NO form fields — the blanks are literal underscores in flat
text — so every value is drawn at a fixed coordinate. These numbers came from
the document's own text positions (pdfjs), not from eyeballing:
page 1 blanks are their own text runs, so x/y are taken straight from them;
page 4 blanks sit inside the label run, so x is the label's x plus the width
of the label text in Times-Bold at that size.
IF THE TEMPLATE IS EVER RE-EXPORTED, THESE ARE ALL WRONG AND NOTHING WILL SAY
SO — the values will simply land in the wrong place on a contract a client
receives. Re-run `node scripts/agreement-preview.mjs` after any change to the
PDF and look at the output before shipping it.
Origin is bottom-left, PDF points, page is A4 (595.32 x 841.92).
`y` is the baseline of the underscores plus a small lift so the text sits on
the line rather than through it. `maxWidth` is the blank's own width — longer
values are shrunk to fit rather than running over the neighbouring text.
